desc:
Glenmoril witches are hiding in the city. We've been able to target around four of them. Investigate and hunt them down.
Beasthood: +2

A Thalmor informant is gathering intel on us in the city. Kill them - we've already arranged a deal with the guards.
Beasthood: +2

Dive into a Falmer lair and recover the inscriptions needed to decipher the ancient language.
Beasthood: +2
Insight: +1

From Lalanoah:
If you find any unusual sweets in your travels, I'd love it if you brought them to me. Please, please do!
Humanity: +2

From Groll:
I'm struggling with this week's menu. If you find any interesting recipes on your travels, please bring them to me.
Humanity: +2

From Lalanoah:
Uncle Brandt is never paying attention, so I decided to ask Kalka to make him a nutritional potion. If you find ingredients for it, please bring them with you.
Humanity: +2

From Brandt:
Remember that big stupid bird we took down some time ago? I heard there's another one on the loose, so I got this handbill running around. What say you to some extra gold?
Humanity: +5
Beasthood: +2

From Kalka:
A gaggle of mushrooms escaped again... It's dangerous to leave them to their own devices, so if you find them, please get rid of them.
Humanity: +2
Insight: +1

From Brandt:
There are more and more mercenary ruffians in Falkreath. You never know what they'll do once they run out of gold. I want you to beat up one of them, especially if they act suspiciously.
Humanity: +2
Beasthood: +1

From Kanra:
Please help my friends.
Humanity: +3
Beasthood: +1

Take care of the defectors listed below. Leave the guidance to me.

Ozwald
<Alias=Player>
In the name of JHUNAL, those who have committed abominations shall be sealed in this land. May no one be enchanted by their curse.
Sinful Hamah and her abominations are hereby hidden away. Until the people forget their names, until the people forget their forms.

Before the twilight devours all,
golden eyes of the abyss will gaze into the sky,
and the ones wearing skins of man and beast will crawl into the light.

O daughters of the hearth gods, may your fire keep burning until dawn.

O Anem, daughter of mercy,
heal even the lowly as they walk the mountains,
lest they be deceived by the beast.

O Zuzu, daughter of silence,
hide all the secrets in your mouth,
lest the people find the beast.

O Hela, daughter of the spinner,
I entrust you with a drop taken from the beast.
Hide it in the forest's depths so that none may be enchanted by it.
